tenderSchedule.title: Supply of Furniture to Government Polytechnic Colleges of the Department of Technical Education
tenderSchedule.description: Supply of Furniture to Government Polytechnic Colleges of the Department of Technical Education
tenderSchedule.remarks: Additional Director Department of Technical Education, Palace Road

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Office of the Director Department of Technical Education Tantrika Shikshana BhavanaPalace Road, Bangalore-560 001

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer who is a manufacturer should have manufactured, tested & executed in a year order of furniture similar type specified in the Schedule of requirements up to 80 percent(40 percent with respect to Micro & Small Enterprises) of the quantity required in any one of the last 3 years (any one of the last two years with respect to Micro & Small Enterprises). Such supplies should have been made to any State/Central Govt Institutions in any one of the last 3 years

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Documentary evidence in the form of PO / Supply order & End User Certificate / Work Completion certificate.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer who is an authorized dealer should have supplied, installed and satisfactorily commissioned furnituresimilar typeas specified in the schedule of requirements upto 30% of the quantity required in any one of the last 3 years along with 80% manufacturer Performance.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Proof of 30 percent & 80 percent Performance in the form of Satisfactory Work Completion Certificate along with Supply Order /Purchase Order

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer (supplier) should be in Business and supplied Furniture during the last 3 Financial Years ( 2023-24, 2024-25& 2025-26

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- PAN Card, ITR Returns, GST Certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer shall be a manufacturer or authorized dealer / agent for supply of furniture. Only manufacturers who have ISO 9001-2015/ISO 14001-2015, the scope clearly indicating for the manufacture of furniture and their authorized dealers/agents are eligible to participate in the Tender.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- ISO Certificates

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer who is a manufacturer or authorized dealer/agent shall quote furniture of a reputed brand manufacturer who is in existence for last 03 years as on 31.03.2026.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- produce one work order for furniture (in the name of the manufacturer) for each of the last 03 years & valid brand (Trade Marks)

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer who is a manufacturer or authorized dealer/agent should submit the sample furniture (All Items,) to Additional Director (P), Department of Technical Education, Palace Road, and get the acknowledgement, Scan and upload the document within the last date and time for submission of Tender. Uploading of documents in e-procurement portal is mandatory.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- relevant documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Average annual Turnover of the bidder should be not less than Rs.400 lakhs in the last 3 (three) completed financial years.(In case of Micro& Small Enterprises the annual turnover of the bidder should be Rs.250 lakhs during the last two preceding financial years) & Positive N/W for last 3 years CA certificate to be submitted (2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26
